title: GAM.AI: Edge AI & Universal Offline Intelligence Platform
description: Zero-dependency Edge AI platform and local-first universal assistant. Operates 100% air-gapped on under 120MB RAM or transitions seamlessly to Hybrid Online Intelligence with Wikipedia REST and DuckDuckGo Lite live web research without external API keys. Features 3 tailored personas (General, Student, NetEng), multi-vendor router provisioning (Cisco, Huawei, FortiGate, MikroTik, Hikvision, OLT/ONT), continuous token safety, and cross-platform native binaries for Android, Linux, Windows, and Web PWA.

title: GAMA: Cybernetic Music & Frequency Audio Platform
description: Native Android audio streaming and frequency manipulation suite built with Jetpack Compose. Inspired by Echo-Music with Nothing OS fluid glassmorphism, real-time LrcLib time-synchronized lyrics with offline caching & micro-calibration, floating capsule mini-player island with horizontal swipe gestures, floating pill navigation dock, lifestyle mood discovery pills, 2-column quick action library grid, trending music instant shuffle, relatable playlists search, automatic Most & Least Played smart playlists, and 432Hz/528Hz biological harmonic frequency tuning.

title: IELTS by GAMA: Hybrid Online + Offline AI English & IELTS Tutor
description: Hybrid Online + Offline AI English learning and IELTS preparation platform. Operates 100% offline with local AI, local SQLite knowledge base, local RAG retrieval, Dr. Harrison Cambridge-certified 3-Part Speaking Examiner simulation with natural British English speech, 4-criterion Formative Writing Studio, Spaced Repetition vocabulary, and native Android APK for phones and tablets.
